reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "[http3] Moves HTTP/3 outside the experimental section (#9570 by sdelicata)", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: HTTP/3 is no longer experimental and is now a stable, supported feature; existing deployments using HTTP/3 continue to function, and new deployments can confidently adopt HTTP/3 without experimental feature risk.

proposed.statement: HTTP/3 protocol support is moved from experimental to stable status and is no longer under an experimental designation.
